ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.12:0.88 macro-ratio of high-intensity white pixels localized at distal tips to low-intensity black pixels across the primary surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white bands localized at the distal tips of both lobes. The left lobe exhibits a larger, more continuous white patch along the upper margin. The right lobe shows a fragmented, mottled pattern of white pixels intermixed with black at the tip and upper-right margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 68 degrees and a pixel-depth roughly 15% of the total vertical extent of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge. High-frequency, low-amplitude jaggedness is visible on the inner curves near the notch. The right lobe displays more pronounced, uneven peaks toward the mid-lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory along the leading edge, with a steeper upward curvature on the right lobe compared to the slightly more horizontal orientation of the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive distribution of small, circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (0.5% to 1.5% of total fluke width) scattered across the black ventral surface, particularly concentrated in the lower central regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and diagonal fine linear marks (rake-like disruptions) visible on both lobes, with a prominent diagonal line crossing the lower-center of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, irregular notch or amputation of pixel mass is visible on the far upper-right tip of the right fluke lobe, distinct from natural serration patterns.
